title: IRON: Implicit Resolvent Optimization under Noise
summary: We study stochastic optimization from a joint continuous-discrete point of view. Starting from a second-order stochastic differential equation interpreted as a noisy accelerated gradient flow, we discretize the dynamics by a fully implicit Backward-Euler scheme. This leads to a resolvent, or proximal-type, update, computed in practice through Levenberg-Marquardt, Newton, or trust-region-type inner solves.
